Solution 3 is correct. The distinct products come from splits with lengths (1,8), (2,7), (3,6), (4,5), giving 899999991, 989999901, 998999001, and 999890001. Their sum is S = 3,888,888,894, which has seven 8s, so its digit sum is 3 + 56 + 9 + 4 = 72.

Solution 1 made an addition error (3,898,888,894). Solution 2 has the correct S but miscounted the digits as eight 8s, giving 80.
